purpose: Implement a pure inspect-before-egress envelope that makes proposed outbound material, provenance, privacy classification, destination, purpose, retention and cost statements explicit and binds artist confirmation to that exact package through CORE-04A, with no transmission capability.

lineage.outcome: Before private or public material crosses a trust boundary, the artist can inspect exactly what would leave, where, why and under which explicit provenance/privacy/rights/consent/retention/cost facts, and confirmation binds only to that exact package.
lineage.capability: Outbound provenance inspection and exact private-data confirmation envelope

legacy_candidates: outbound context inspector and consent semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: preview exposes every exact material item, category, source, revision, privacy flag, represented rights/consent reference, destination, purpose, retention statement and cost statement
private material IDs and data categories derive only from explicit material facts
confirmation delegates to CORE-04A exact ActionIntent fingerprint binding and unchanged package validates as VALID

changing material identity/category/source/revision/privacy/rights/consent, adding or removing material, or changing request/job/description/destination/purpose/retention/cost makes prior confirmation STALE
material input order canonicalizes without changing the outbound or authority fingerprint
duplicate material IDs, malformed privacy flags and blank outbound explanation fields are rejected
OutboundInspector public API contains preview, bind_confirmation and validate_confirmation only with no send/upload/transmit/request/model/provider/network/execute path
preview and confirmation validation are deterministic and pure
no external action, credential access, provider call or network transport occurs
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04B evidence, reconcile and globally compare transactional execution/recovery, universal provider receipts/reconciliation and network/offline trust against preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not add transport merely because the outbound package is now approvable.
